body:
Raise the default time limit for each build step from 120 seconds to 2400 seconds (40 minutes).

Scope: the default only — a step that sets its own `timeout` in `solace.toml` keeps it (e.g. the self-build's `bundle` step stays at 600s).

For the agent: the default is `recipe.TIMEOUT`, and `board::builds.execute` falls back to 120 when a step has no timeout; change both, and update tests that assert 120 for build steps (e.g. `recipe::tests.each_project_kind_gets_its_default`, `recipe::tests.the_self_build_bundles_before_the_crate`) plus any docs describing the build default. Leave other 120s limits (probe, cargo fetch, tool commands, smoke checks) alone.
title: build: default step timeout 2400s
